title: The Computer Revolution Hasn't Happened Yet (OOPSLA keynote)
author: Alan Kay
publisher: ACM OOPSLA '97, Atlanta; recording widely mirrored
alt_text: Alan Kay's keynote arguing that computing has not yet had its printing-press moment — that we are still in the incunabula, imitating old media instead of achieving a new literacy.
notes: Kay's recurring analogy: personal computing awaits its Gutenberg and its mass-literacy campaign.
